projects.name: Skybooker
projects.one_liner: AI-assisted flight search, seat selection, and itinerary management platform built independently during LTM training.
projects.problem: Manual flight comparison and multi-leg trip tracking often fragment seat selection, fare alerts, and itinerary updates across disconnected tools.
projects.contribution: Independently designed and built end-to-end across frontend UI, REST APIs, JWT authentication, booking workflows, and admin management.
projects.architecture: React + TypeScript SPA communicating with an Express/Node.js REST API, JWT role-based guards, and Gemini API itinerary assistant.
features: Flight search with filtering, fare alerts, and interactive seat selection
End-to-end booking lifecycle and trip itinerary management
AI-assisted travel chat and itinerary planning via Gemini API
Role-protected admin dashboard for flight and booking controls

projects.name: SafarMate AI
projects.one_liner: AI-powered travel agency platform supporting natural-language package discovery, bookings, and JWT-secured user flows.
projects.problem: Travellers struggle to map open-ended trip preferences to structured tour packages while agencies need reliable booking and feedback tracking.
projects.contribution: Led the LTM Gladiator team; architected system flows, contributed to Spring Boot REST controllers, JWT security filters, and Angular integration.
projects.architecture: Angular SPA with HTTP Bearer interceptor talking to Spring Boot 3.1.5 (Java 17) services, Hibernate/JPA repositories, MySQL, and Gemini API.
features: Natural-language package discovery powered by Gemini structured preference extraction
Stateless JWT authentication filter with role-based route guards
Package browsing, booking confirmation, and traveller feedback workflows
Relational MySQL schema managed via Spring Data JPA and Hibernate

projects.source_note: LTM Gladiator training project — source not public

projects.name: PhishNet
projects.one_liner: Anti-phishing URL analyzer combining lexical heuristics, feature extraction, and scan history inspection.
projects.problem: Suspicious links frequently disguise deceptive domains and redirect chains that bypass casual visual inspection.
projects.contribution: Designed and implemented the URL feature extraction pipeline, classification workflow, and React + TypeScript inspection interface.
projects.architecture: React + Vite + TypeScript frontend paired with URL lexical/structural feature extraction and ML classification scoring.
features: Multi-signal URL lexical and structural feature inspection
Heuristic + ML classification verdict with risk breakdown
Persistent scan history for reviewing previously checked links
Responsive cybersecurity analysis dashboard

projects.name: CryptoWeather Nexus
projects.one_liner: Real-time intelligence dashboard unifying cryptocurrency market feeds, global weather data, and news sentiment.
projects.problem: Tracking live crypto tickers, macro weather events, and market news usually requires switching across isolated dashboards.
projects.contribution: Built the Next.js + TypeScript application, Redux Toolkit state layer, WebSocket price stream handling, and Recharts visualizations.
projects.architecture: Next.js App Router + Redux Toolkit consuming live WebSocket market streams, weather APIs, and news feeds, containerized with Docker.
features: Live cryptocurrency price streaming over WebSockets
Global city weather metrics and historical trend charts
Aggregated financial/crypto news feed integration
Containerized deployment setup with Docker

projects.name: TotalFit
projects.one_liner: Athlete wellness platform connecting fitness activity telemetry with recovery indicators and injury-risk insights.
projects.problem: Athletes and coaches lack unified visibility linking daily training load with recovery readiness and injury signals.
projects.contribution: Architected and built the Next.js + TypeScript frontend and integrated Supabase/Google Fit activity data with AI insight generation.
projects.architecture: Next.js + TypeScript web client backed by Supabase/PostgreSQL storage, Google Fit telemetry sync, and AI wellness scoring.
features: Activity and fitness telemetry ingestion via Google Fit
Recovery readiness and workload trend visualizations
AI-generated wellness and injury-risk awareness insights
Persistent athlete profile and session history

projects.name: LeakSense
projects.one_liner: Connected IoT gas-leakage and air-quality (AQI) monitoring system with live sensor telemetry and alerts.
projects.problem: Delayed detection of hazardous gas leaks and indoor air degradation creates safety risks in residential and industrial spaces.
projects.contribution: Developed the sensor telemetry pipeline connecting hardware gas/temperature readings to Firebase/ThingSpeak and the Flutter mobile UI.
projects.architecture: IoT gas & temperature sensors streaming telemetry to ThingSpeak and Firebase Realtime DB, consumed by a Flutter monitoring app.
features: Continuous gas concentration, temperature, and AQI monitoring
Real-time cloud sync via Firebase and ThingSpeak channels
Threshold-based hazard alert notifications
Cross-platform Flutter mobile monitoring interface

projects.name: IndiVerse
projects.one_liner: Multilingual desktop chat application supporting real-time messaging with server-side language translation.
projects.problem: Language barriers slow down real-time collaboration across multilingual user groups.
projects.contribution: Built the Python/PyQt5 client interface and real-time socket/translation messaging pipeline.
projects.architecture: Python PyQt5 desktop client communicating with a real-time messaging server performing per-recipient message translation.
features: Real-time bidirectional chat messaging across clients
Automatic server-side translation to each user's preferred language
Desktop GUI built with Python and PyQt5
